info.description:
# ASP Integration Endpoints - Google
## Typical Transaction Flow

| Action | Endpoint | Status Code | Description |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| Get Device | `GET /sctapi/device{device_id}` | **n/a** | Retrieve device warranty status and confirm authorization to repair a product line. Extended Warranty information provided if applicable. Important `notes` included to indicate when a device may be eligible for extended repair to display as alert to user.|
| Create Claim | `POST /sctapi/claims` | **received** | Create a new claim/rma. Returns `claim.id` and `authorizer_reference` (Google RMA ID). Extended Warranty information provided if applicable. Important `notes` included to indicate when a device may be eligible for extended repair to display as alert to user.|
| Submit Triage | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **triaged**| Send triage codes for disposition. *Repair_Authorized*: suggested repair actions/parts are returned. *Whole_Unit_Replacement* or *Do_Not_Repair*: Claim is closed and applicable service payments are returned. May be submitted multiple times to add triage codes. If eligible for Extended Repair as designated by `notes` in GET Device and Create Claim responses and device is eligible for a Fix On Touch (FOT) repair additional error response may indicate to include additional triage codes.
| Initiate Repair | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **in_repair** | Records the start of the repair. |
| Hold Repair* | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **on_hold** | Places repair in holding pattern (i.e. awaiting parts). |
| Resume Repair* | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **in_repair** | Resumes repair from hold. |
| Submit Repair | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **in_repair**| Submit repair outcome, completed repair actions and parts used. Returns repair validation outcome and calculated payment totals. May be submitted multiple times to correct errors or update repair details (Note: resubmissions overwrite previous submissions so all defects / repair actions / parts used must be resubmitted with any changes ). |
| Complete Repair |  `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **repaired** | Finalizes repair actions and payment from last *Submit Repair* request. Captures overall repair outcome, diagnostic compliance and final imei, serial, and software versions.
| Device Returned | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **returned** | Records when device has been returned to the customer. |
| Cancel Repair* | `PUT /sctapi/claims/{claim_id}` | **cancelled** | Cancels a Claim/RMA (allowed at any status prior to Complete Repair). |
*optional flow


## Base Endpoints
* **Test Environment**:  https://googletest.servicecentral.com/sctapi/
* **Production Environment**: https://google.servicecentral.com/sctapi/

## Authentication
 Requests are authenticated with a base64 encoded key included in the request header.

The following http header must be sent with all requests:

**X-API-KEY: {Encoded Key}**

The Test environment key will be provided to the ASP during the onboard phase and production environment key will be provided during connection testing for the Go Live phase.  Keys will be sent via a secure link to the ASP contact responsible for handling key configuration.

A missing or invalid key will result in a 401 Unauthorized error response.


## VERSION NOTES
* **1.0.1**: Added optional 'url' field to POST/PUT /locations methods - overrides ASP "Company URL" in GSP

## Create Claim/RMA
Instructions for ASPs:
- `ticket_gid`: Provide your internal work order ID or sales ID.
- `location_id`: Provide your store ID, must match `location.gid` from GET /locations response.
- `equipment.software`: If the device is not operable you may send "NA" to indicate the software version on intake is Not Available.


**Important**: Capture the `claim.id` from the response to be provided in subsequent API calls to update the Claim/RMA.


**Timestamps**: Timestamps should be sent as the local time of the in a format of "**2021-08-03T06:32:00+00:00**" with timezone represented.

status.description: Report status as received when creating the Claim/RMA

location_id.description: Provide your store ID, must match location.gid {provider_code}|{location_id})

ticket_gid.description: Provide your internal work order ID or sales ID

receipt_type.description:
Indicates the method device was received by claim location.
- `WALK_IN`: Device delivered by customer walking into store. Default for google-walk-in program.
- `COURIER`: Device delivered by non-mail carrier (e.g., motorcycle courier).
- `PACKAGE_CARRIER`: Device delivered by non-mail carrier (e.g., motorcycle courier). Default for google-mail-in program.

lead_reference.description: Provide GSP Lead ID (32-char guid) or ASP Lead ID returned to GSP at lead creation to associate lead with claim.

code.description: must match a code retrieved from the GET /defect-codes API

software.description: provide the build number from device settings

sku.description: provide the SKU that was returned from GET /device/{device_id}

ticketItemsAll.description: Ignore. Not used for Google claims.

200.description:
OK 
### Claim #
  * Capture and save the `claim.id` and `authorizer_reference` on your ticket/workorder.
  * `claim.id` will be used when calling PUT /google-claims/{claim_id} to process the claim and update the status.
  * `authorizer_reference` is a helpful reference when submitting support tickets. 

### Extended Warranty
  * When a device is enrolled in an Extended Warranty program the `extended_warranty` property may be included in the response.  If there is no `partner_enrollment_id` and `extended_warranty_id` this property will be null.
  * `extended_warranty` and `extended_warranty_partner_details` include information about the Extended Warranty partner the device is enrolled with and any claim references that may be applicable at the time of request.

### Notes (Extended Repair Eligible Alert)
  * The `notes` array is included when a device is flagged as eligible for a specific extended repair program.  This may be a program that allows for repair due to a known issue with the display or battery for example. The `important` flag will indicate that this note should be displayed as an alert or pop-up to the user.

receipt_type.description: Indicates the method device was received by claim location

notes.description: Notes marked as important indicate messages that should be shown as alerts the the user. Check if notes array is not null(array is only included in response if one or more notes are returned).

note_text.example: Device may be eligible for a Google authorized Extended Repair Program but further evaluation is required (full triage) to confirm if the device meets the eligibility criteria.

put.description:
# Update claim repair status

Use this endpoint to update the claim as it progresses through the workflow.

**Happy Path Transaction Flow**\
Create RMA **>** Submit Triage **>** Initiate Repair **>** Submit Repair Actions **>** Complete Repair **>** Return Device
  * `authorization_code` when repair authorized:
    * REPAIR_AUTHORIZED

**Non-Repair Path Transaction Flow**\
Create RMA **>** Submit Triage\
  * `authorization_code` when non-repair:
    * DO_NOT_REPAIR*: no further action required.
    * WHOLE_UNIT_REPLACEMENT*: initiate exchange process with Gstore.
    * REPLACEMENT_CLAIM_REPLACEMENT*: initiate exchange process with Extended Warranty partner.\
  *NOTE: GSP claim is closed automatically with above non-repair authorizations.*

**Hold/Resume Path Transaction Flow**\
Create RMA **>** Submit Triage **>** Initiate Repair **>** Hold Repair\
Resume Repair **>** Submit Repair Actions **>** Complete Repair **>** Return Device

**Cancel Path Transaction Flow**\
Create RMA **>** Submit Triage **>** Cancel Repair **>** Return Device\
Create RMA **>** Submit Triage **>** Initiate Repair **>** Cancel Repair **>** Return Device\
Create RMA **>** Submit Triage **>** Initiate Repair **>** Submit Repair Actions **>** Cancel Repair **>** Return Device

**Timestamps**: Timestamps should be sent as the local time of the in a format of "**2021-08-03T06:32:00+00:00**" with timezone represented. 

**Note the following:** 
  * Once repair step has started with *Initiate Repair* no additional t-codes can be added to the claim. Any additional defects encountered should be submitted as q-codes or f-codes during the *Submit Repair* phase.
  * Repair actions must be performed/reported in same sequence as `suggested_actions` return in *Submit Triage* response.
  * If a repair action is unsuccessful `outcome` should be indicated as "DNR" and `outcome_reason` specified.
  * If a repair action is successful, `outcome` should be indicated as "R" and no subsequent repair actions should be performed.
  * No changes can be made to the claim after progressing to *Complete Repair*.

parameters.name: claim_id
parameters.description: claim identifier. Can be a claim id or provider external ticket number. Required. Max length of 30 characters.

repairability_reason.description: Reported with triaged status, only when unrepairable.

hold_reason.description: Reported with on_hold status to indicate the reason for placing the repair on hold.

cancel_reason.description: Reported with cancelled status to indicate the reason for cancellling the Claim/RMA.

ticket_gid.description:
For Monty claims, ASP ticket or workorder reference # to the transaction record in ASP system can be reported during Submit Triage. If no value is provided,
the ticket_gid will be set to the same value as the claim id in GSP.

notes.description: Notes are optional and can be submitted with any status update

equipment.description:
Equipment information provided with status updates to report device details.

**For 'repaired' status**: Reports software, serial, and IMEI of the device after repair completion
**For 'returned' status**: Can optionally report device information when different from original (replacement/upgrade scenarios)

software.description: provide the build number from device settings (primarily for repaired status)

serial.description: provide the serial number of the device (post repair or replacement device)

imei.description: provide the imei of the device (post repair or replacement device)

shipment.description:
Shipment tracking information provided with the 'returned' status for PACKAGE_CARRIER mail-in repairs (program = 'google-mail-in').

**Required for**: program = 'google-mail-in' AND ReceiptType = 'PACKAGE_CARRIER'
**Optional for**: All other scenarios

tracking_number.description: Carrier tracking number for the return shipment to customer

carrier_code.description: Carrier code as configured in RAR_COURIER.COU_CODE (e.g., DHL for Mexico Simtech)

carrier_service.description: Service level offered by the carrier for the shipment

estimated_delivery_time.description: UTC timestamp of estimated delivery date and time

estimated_shipment_time.description: UTC timestamp when shipment was created/tendered to carrier. Defaults to current time if not provided.

shipment_type.description: Shipment method - should match original claim receipt_type

ship_to.description: Customer return address where shipment will be delivered

ship_from.description: Source address where shipment originates (ASP location)

shipment_unavailable.description:
Indicates that shipment tracking information is not available for this return.

**Required for**: program = 'google-mail-in' AND ReceiptType = 'PACKAGE_CARRIER' when tracking info unavailable
**Mutually Exclusive**: Cannot be provided with shipment object

unavailable_reason.description:
Required when shipment_unavailable is true. Indicates reason why shipment tracking is not available.

**MISSING_TRACKING_INFO**: Tracking number not available from carrier
**NON_CARRIER_RETURN**: Device returned by customer pickup or other non-carrier method
**REPLACED_BY_OTHER_SOURCE**: Replacement device provided from alternate source

t_codes.description: t_codes are provided with the triaged status to indicate the defect codes that were observed during triage, before repair initiation

repairability.description: Reported with triaged status to indicate whether defect is repairable, unrepairable or if no fault found.

repair_actions.description: Reported with in_repair status to indicate which repair actions were performed and their outcomes.

f_codes.description: f_codes are provided with the in_repair status to indicate the defect codes that were observed during repair, before reassembly of the device

repair_actions.description: Reported with in_repair status to indicate which repair actions were performed and their outcomes.

q_codes.description: q_codes are provided with the in_repair status to indicate the defect codes that were observed after repair, during OQC of the device

repair_actions.description: Reported with in_repair status to indicate which repair actions were performed and their outcomes.

Submit Triage.description:
## Submit Triage
Submit the results of triage in order to receive repair authorization.
Look at the **authorization_code** in the triaged response to determine whether or not to proceed with the repair.
- **REPAIR_AUTHORIZED**: repair is authorized, proceed with repair
- **DO_NOT_REPAIR**: repair is not authorized, do not repair
- **WHOLE_UNIT_REPLACEMENT**: replacement is authorized, do not repair
- **REPLACEMENT_CLAIM_RECOMMENDED**: recommend replacement via extended warranty partner claim, do no repair.
## Expected Responses
Be sure to check each response example for additional information.
- Submit Triage (Repair Authorized)
- Submit Triage (Repair Not Authorized)
- Submit Triage (Replacement Authorized)

Submit Triage (Unrepairable).description:
## Submit Triage
Submit the results of triage in order to receive repair authorization.
Look at the **authorization_code** in the triaged response to determine whether or not to proceed with the repair.
- **REPAIR_AUTHORIZED**: repair is authorized, proceed with repair
- **DO_NOT_REPAIR**: repair is not authorized, do not repair
- **WHOLE_UNIT_REPLACEMENT**: replacement is authorized, do not repair
- **REPLACEMENT_CLAIM_RECOMMENDED**: recommend replacement via extended warranty partner claim, do no repair.
## Repairability Reason
If any triage code is indicated as Unrepairable, you must report the reason from the following:
- **INSUFFICIENT_PARTS**: The device cannot be repaired because the ASP does not have sufficient parts to complete the repair.
- **SAFETY_HAZARD**: The device cannot be repaired because repairing it would be hazardous, for example because of a leaking battery.
- **SEVERE_OOW_DAMAGE**: The device cannot be repaired because there is severe damage that would not be covered under warranty.
## Expected Responses
Be sure to check each response example for additional information.
- Submit Triage (Repair Not Authorized)
- Submit Triage (Replacement Authorized)

Cancel Claim/RMA.description:
## Cancel a Repair
If the repair needs to be cancelled for any reason, send this request along with a cancel reason.  The following reason codes are accepted.
- **CUSTOMER_DECLINED**: select this reason if the customer chooses not to proceed with the repair
- **INCOMPATIBLE_DISPOSITION**: select this reason if you accidentally reported the wrong t-codes or if you need to split out IW and OOW t-codes into separate Claims/RMAs.

Initiate Repair.description:
## Initiate Repair
Send the "In Repair" request to initiate repair after triage completion. Repair actions are not accepted at this stage.

Hold Repair.description:
## Place Repair On Hold
If the repair needs to be placed on hold for any reason, send this request along with a hold reason.  When ready to resume the repair, send the "In Repair" request.
## Hold Reasons
- **AWAITING_CALLBACK**: The repair is pending confirmation from the customer, for example when a repair will cost the customer more money for OOW portions than previously agreed
- **AWAITING_PARTS**: The repair is on hold due to not having parts to complete it

notes.note: Waiting for call back from customer

Resume Repair.description:
## Resume Repair
Send the "In Repair" request to resume a repair after it was placed on hold.

Submit Repair Actions (Successful).description:
## Submit Repair Results
Submit the results of repair in order to receive repair approval and payment.

Submit Repair Actions (Unsuccessful).description:
## Submit Repair Results
Submit the results of repair in order to receive repair approval and payment.
### Repair Outcome Reason
If any repair action does not resolve the triage code, a reason from the following must be reported.
- DID_NOT_RESOLVE
- INSUFFICIENT_PARTS
- CUSTOMER_DECLINED

Submit Repair Actions (With F-codes or Q.description:
## Submit Repair Results
Submit the results of repair in order to receive repair approval and payment.  If additional damages are observed or caused after repair was started, those codes must be reported as follows:
- **f-codes**: these represent defects or damages that were discovered before reassembling the phone.
- **q-codes**: these represent defects or damages that were discovered after reassembling the phone, during outgoing quality control
***
Important: f-codes and q-codes are not eligible for reimbursement.

Complete Repair.description:
## Mark Repair as Completed
Send the "Complete Repair" request to mark the repair as completed.  After doing so the claim will be finalized and no more changes will be allowed by the ASP.\
\
If all triage codes were repaired successfully, send "Successful" as the outcome.\
\
If any of the triage codes were not successfully repaired send "Unsuccessful" as the outcome.\

### OQC Diganostics
* `confirm_oqc`: required when ASP is mandated to run diagnostics during OQC.
* `oqc_non_compliance_reason`*: required when dianositic check is mandated for ASP and confirm_oqc is false.
    * Valid enum values:
        - OOW_RMA
        - POOR_WIFI_CONNECTION
        - FORGOT_AND_DEVICE_ALREADY_RETURNED
        - UNTRAINED_ON_DIAGNOSTIC_PROCESS
        - FALSE_FAILURE_SPECIFY_TEST_ITEM
        - OTHER_REASON_PLEASE_SPECIFY
* `oqc_non_compliance_reason_details`: Free-form text. Required if oqc_non_compliance_reason provided is **FALSE_FAILURE_SPECIFY_TEST_ITEM** or **OTHER_REASON_PLEASE_SPECIFY**

### IMEI Out Required
`equipment.imei` field is required when a mainboard repair action (ex R04) with outcome Resolved (R) was included during Submit Repair step, This field should indicate the imei for the Replacement Mainboard/Known Good Board.

Return Device (Standard Non-Mail-In).description:
## Return Device to Customer (Standard Non-Mail-In)
Send the "Returned" request to indicate when the device was returned to the customer.\
\
**Note**: Returned event should follow cancelled, rejected, repaired, replacement status event.

### Usage for Standard Non-Mail-In
This example applies to the following scenarios:
- **google-walk-in** program (all receipt types)
- **google-mail-in** program with ReceiptType = **WALK_IN** or **COURIER**

For these scenarios, shipment tracking information is not required or applicable since:
- Walk-in customers pick up their devices in person
- Courier delivery doesn't require package carrier tracking

### Note on Mail-in Package Carrier
For **google-mail-in** program with ReceiptType = **PACKAGE_CARRIER**, use the "Return Device with Shipment Tracking" example instead to provide customer tracking visibility.

Return Device with Shipment Tracking (Go.description:
## Return Device to Customer with Shipment Tracking
Example for Google mail-in repairs (program = "google-mail-in") with PACKAGE_CARRIER receipt type.
Include shipment tracking information to provide customer tracking visibility.

This will trigger:
1. Data storage in RAR_SHIPMENT entities
2. Synchronous call to Google Shipment Metadata API
3. Async retry mechanism if Google API fails

Return Device - Shipment Unavailable (Go.description:
## Return Device to Customer - Shipment Unavailable
Example for Google mail-in repairs (program = "google-mail-in") with PACKAGE_CARRIER receipt type when shipment tracking is unavailable.
Use this when tracking information cannot be provided for various business reasons.

This will trigger:
1. Storage of unavailable reason in GOOGLE_CLAIM.ShipmentUnavailableReason for reporting
2. No call to Google Shipment Metadata API (no tracking data available)
3. Claim marked as returned without customer tracking visibility

Return Device with Equipment Info (Repla.description:
## Return Device to Customer with Equipment Information
Example for returning a replacement or upgrade device using the equipment object.
Use this when the device being returned differs from the original claim device.

**Usage**: Include equipment object when returning a different device (replacement/upgrade scenarios)
**For Google Mail-in PACKAGE_CARRIER**: Can be combined with shipment object for tracking

This will trigger:
1. Device change detection and SN_CLAIM field updates (DEVICE_IMEI_OUT, DEVICE_SERIAL_OUT)
2. IM_UNIT record creation for replacement device
3. FS_WORK_ORDER exchange tracking field updates
4. If combined with shipment: Google Shipment Metadata API call with replacement device information

await_customer_confirmation.description: (MONTY) indicates specified authorization is on hold until confirmed with customer. Claim will not be able to progress to in_repair while await_customer_confirm is true.

extended_warranty_status.description: indicates defect status for Preferred Care extended warranty coverage

Submit Triage (Repair Not Authorized).description:
# Submit Triage (Repair Not Authorized)
If the **authorization_code** provided in the response is **DO_NOT_REPAIR**, it means the ASP is not authorized to perform the repair on behalf of Google.\
\
In this scenario it is not necessary to cancel the Claim/RMA or mark the device as returned in GSP.\
\
If the repair is not authorized by Google and a triage fee is due to the ASP from Google, the **approved_service_level** will indicate the service level of triage performed and the **approved_services_price** will indicate the fee that Google will pay to the ASP for performing the triage.\
\
If the repair channel is ASP managed mail-in and a mail-in fee is due to the ASP from Google, the **approved_mail_in_fee** will indicate the fee that Google will pay the ASP for return shipping the device to the customer.\
\
The **approved_payment_amount** will indicate the total amount Google will pay to the ASP for triage services rendered to the customer.

Submit Triage (IW Replacement Authorized.description:
# Submit Triage (Replacement Authorized)
If the **authorization_code** provided in the response is **WHOLE_UNIT_REPLACEMENT**, it means the customer is eligible to receive a replacement device from Google and the ASP is not authorized to perform the repair on behalf of Google.\
\
In this scenario it is not necessary to cancel the Claim/RMA or mark the device as returned in GSP.\
\
If the repair is not authorized by Google and a triage fee is due to the ASP from Google, the **approved_service_level** will indicate the service level of triage performed and the **approved_services_price** will indicate the fee that Google will pay to the ASP for performing the triage.\
\
If the repair channel is ASP managed mail-in and a mail-in fee is due to the ASP from Google, the **approved_mail_in_fee** will indicate the fee that Google will pay the ASP for return shipping the device to the customer.\
\
The **approved_payment_amount** will indicate the total amount Google will pay to the ASP for services rendered to the customer.

Submit Triage (Extended Warranty Replace.description:
# Submit Triage (Preferred Care Replacement Recommended)
If the **authorization_code** provided in the response is **REPLACEMENT_CLAIM_RECOMMENDED**, it means the customer is eligible to receive a replacement device from a Preferred Care partner and the ASP is not authorized to perform the repair on behalf of Google.\
\
In this scenario it is not necessary to cancel the Claim/RMA or mark the device as returned in GSP.\
\
If the repair is not authorized by Google and a triage fee is due to the ASP from Google, the **approved_service_level** will indicate the service level of triage performed and the **approved_services_price** will indicate the fee that Google will pay to the ASP for performing the triage.\
\
If the repair channel is ASP managed mail-in and a mail-in fee is due to the ASP from Google, the **approved_mail_in_fee** will indicate the fee that Google will pay the ASP for return shipping the device to the customer.\
\
The **approved_payment_amount** will indicate the total amount Google will pay to the ASP for services rendered to the customer.

Cancel Claim/RMA.description:
# Cancel Claim
If triage has been performed on the claim and cancel reason is CUSTOMER_DECLINED the claim may qualify in some cases for payment of the triage service performed. If the claim does not qualify the `approved_service_level` will be shown with approved quoted prices.

500.description:
### Extended Repair - FIX ON TOUCH - Submit Additional T-Codes

This error occurs when a device is eligible for a Google authorized Extended Repair Program 
(such as Fix On Touch/FOT) and the submitted triage codes do not cover the eligible Extended Repair Fix On Touch defect.

Additional triage codes will need to be submitted to include the repair for the Fix On Touch eligible defect.

**When this error occurs:**
- The device has been flagged as potentially eligible for an extended repair program
- The initial triage codes submitted do not include defect in category of Fix On Touch defect (i.e. Display category)
- Additional specific triage code(s) will need to be submitted for Fix On Touch defect to be repaired
- You must resubmit the triage request with additional defect codes

**Usage Notes:**
- Review/display the error message for guidance on additional codes needed
- Add the required additional triage codes to your request
- Resubmit the PUT request with the complete set of triage codes

message.example: This device is eligible for free display replacement. Please ensure defect code 'T192' is submitted.

get.description:
Verify device diagnostic result
- `claim_id`: (url param): Required. Claim Code or ID.
- `station` (query param): Required. Indicates diagnostic phase. 
    * Valid values:
      * **Triage**: indicate when checking for post-initial triage
      * **OQC**: indicate when checking for post-repair completion or post outgoing quality control
- `imei_tested` (query param): Optional. IMEI diagnostic test was run on. If OQC, this will be the final imei out.
- `serial_tested` (query param): Optional. Serial during diagnostic test was run on. If OQC, this will be the final serial out.

NOTE: Either `imei_tested` or `serial_tested` is required.

OK

### Product Line Authorization
  * `product_line_authorization` is based on the Model Family service inclusions/exclusions set for the ASP + Location in GSP.  If `NOT_AUTHORIZED` this indicates that either the ASP or Location has not been given authorization to service this product line and to not proceed with the claim.  If `NOT_AUTHORIZED` and the product line should be please contact your Google Operations Manager for assistance.

### Extended Warranty
  * When a device is enrolled in an Extended Warranty program the `extended_warranty` property may be included in the response.  If there is no `partner_enrollment_id` and `extended_warranty_id` this property will be null.
  * `extended_warranty` and `extended_warranty_partner_details` include information about the Extended Warranty partner the device is enrolled with and any claim references that may be applicable at the time of request.

### Notes (Extended Repair Eligible Alert)

This may be a program that allows for repair due to a known issue with the display or battery for example. The `important` flag will indicate that this note should be displayed as an alert or pop-up to the user.

post.summary: Add, remove and update select ASP locations or sync all ASP locations
post.description:
## Post ASP locations to the GSP network. (QA)
Locations can be maintained in one of two primary modes, specified in the request payload
* **Sync**: locations not included in the request payload are considered to be inactive and all programs are removed from the location.
    * If you use `sync` you must send all active locations in each request.

* **AddRemove**: New locations are created and existing locations are updated. Any locations specified in the `removed` array are deactivated.
    * Performs an upsert on one or more locations included in request. The PUT /locations method is not necessary as all updates can be performed on existing locations using POST /locations.

**Important**: 

* By default, all new locations are added to program **google-walk-in** when no program is specified.  ASP may opt out of either program by putting "remove" in the "action" field. To add the **google-mail-in** a Programs array must be completed with valid authorizer, code "google-mail-in", and action "add.

* **At least one service day** (ex: monday_start & monday_end) **is required** for a location to be added to the GSP system and deemed serviceable by a GSP operations manager. If all service hours are null or 00:00, the location will be flagged inactive and not servicable.

**Deactivate Location**:

* **Permanently Inactive**: Setting 'expiration_date' will make a location permanently inactive as of the date specified.

* **Temporarily Inactive**: Removing all 'programs' for a location will make the location temporarily inactive.  Adding 1 or more 'programs' back will reactive the location.

**Programs**:
  * A location must be associated to one or more programs in order to create claims.
    * google-walk-in
    * google-mail-in

mode.description:
locations maintenence mode. Possible values are "sync" and "addremove"

Sync - 

in sync mode, the request payload is expected to contain all active locations for the given provider. Locations currently in the GSP system that do not have a correlating object in the request payload (identified by location gid) will be considered inactive. 

AddRemove - 

in add/remove mode, the request payload is expected to contain only new locations. To remove locations from the given ASP, an array of location gid strings can be passed via the 'removed' property. (See 'removed' documentation below)

get.summary: Retrieve counts of model/part inventory tracked in GSP

post.description:
# Update provider location inventory by location
**Important**: When sending parts inventory, instock quantity cannot be used in combination with pristine, damaged, or doa.  Consider the following scenarios:
* **Update Stock Level**: To update GSP to match your current stock level, pass the instock quantity and GSP will be updated accordingly.
* **Increment Stock Level**: To increment your current stock level in GSP, pass the number of new parts that were added to inventory using the pristine quantity.
* **Decrement Stock Level**: To decrement your current stock level in GSP, pass the number of damaged and/or doa parts.

post.summary: ASP Hosted Webhook to receive confirm/cancel/location notifications for Monty claims
post.description:
## Instructions for ASPs:
- This endpoint is a webhook for Monty integrated ASPs to receive notifications from GSP for Monty claims / new Monty locations
- ASP should expose the webhook at ASP Hosted URL per these specifications and provide host url to GSP (i.e. https://asprepairportal.com/api/google-monty/notification)
- This is an unauthenticated endpoint. GSP will notify the ASP of a new action with the callback url and ASP will need to make the authenticated GET before finalizing any action on the claim.  The GET callback will verify the notification and follow up data.

## Action
- Confirm
    - Indicates a Monty claim authorization awaiting customer confirmation has been approved and may progress. See POST /google-claims/{claim_id} response example 'Submit Triage (MONTY) Await Customer Confirmation for example of Submit Triage response that initially indicates claim is awaiting customer confirmation.
- Cancel
    - Indicates a Monty claim has been cancelled by Gstore and ticket/workorder needs to be cancelled.
- Location
    - Indicates a new Monty location has been added in GSP. ASP will perform GET /google-location callback to retreive location details to create the location in their system.

action.description: indicates action associated with notification (confirm, cancel, location)

status_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of when update to claim was recorded

claim_id.description: GSP claim code. Required when action is 'Confirm' or 'cancel'.

location_gid.description: External location id. Required when action is 'location'.

request_id.description: Unique guid associated with notification. Allows GSP to track notification callback.

callback_url.description: URL to validate notification action and retrieve data related to claim/location via authenticated channel.

get.summary: Retrieve claim data for Monty location
get.description:

- This endpoint is to retrieve claim data for a Monty claim to create ticket/workorder in ASP system. When location is a Monty location and GET /device returns open_claim = true and is_monty_claim = true, ASP will call this endpoint to retrieve claim data.

get.summary: Callback endpoint for confirm or cancel action to POST /google-monty/notification
get.description:
## Instructions for ASPs:
- This endpoint is to verify and retrieve data related to confirmed authorization or claim cancellation as a result of a notification from GSP (see POST /google-monty/notification webhook specification )

## Action
- Confirm
    - Reflects last Submit Triage authorization / suggested repairs with `await_customer_confirmation = false`
- Cancel
    - Response is the same as PUT /google-claims/{claim_id} cancel request.  For Monty, no service fees will be calculated/quoted in GSP response.

post.summary: ASP Hosted Webhook to receive notification of lead events
post.description:
## Instructions for ASPs:
- This endpoint is a webhook for Lead integrated ASPs to receive notifications from GSP for lead events
- ASP should expose the webhook at ASP Hosted URL per these specifications and provide host url to GSP (i.e. https://asprepairportal.com/api/google-lead/notification)
- This is an unauthenticated endpoint. GSP will notify the ASP of a new action with the callback url and ASP will need to make the authenticated GET before finalizing any action on the lead.  The GET callback will verify the notification and follow up data.

## Action
- Create
    - Indicates a new lead has been created in GSP. ASP will perform callback to retrieve lead details to create the lead in their system.
- Cancel
    - Indicates a lead has been cancelled by GSP and should be cancelled in ASP system.

action.description: indicates action associated with notification (create, cancel)

status_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of when update to lead was recorded

lead_id.description: GSP lead ID. Required for all lead actions.

request_id.description: Unique guid associated with notification. Allows GSP to track notification callback.

callback_url.description: URL to validate notification action and retrieve data related to lead via authenticated channel.

get.summary: Retrieve repair leads within date range
get.description:
## Instructions for ASPs:
- Retrieve leads based on optional filters: provider, from_date, and to_date
- All parameters are optional - omitting all parameters returns all accessible leads
- Provider parameter filters by service provider code
- Date parameters use YYYY-MM-DD format
- Results are sorted by creation date (newest first)

## Access Control:
- If authenticated as a provider, results are automatically filtered to leads for   that provider's locations
- If authenticated as authorizer, results can be filtered by provider parameter

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Service provider code to filter leads

ew_enrollment.description: Indicates if device has extended warranty  enrollment

ew_claim.description: Indicates if extended warranty claim exists

claim_id.description: Associated claim code if lead was converted

get.description:
## Instructions for ASPs:
- Retrieve lead(s) matching the provided identifier
- The lead_identifier parameter supports multiple search types:
  - GSP Lead ID (internal database ID)
  - Authorizer Reference
  - Device IMEI
  - Device Serial Number
- Search is case-insensitive
- Returns 404 if no matching lead is found

## Access Control:
- If authenticated as a provider, results are automatically filtered to leads for   that provider's locations
- Providers can only access leads associated with their locations

parameters.name: lead_identifier
parameters.description: Lead identifier (GSP ID, Authorizer Reference, IMEI, or Serial Number)
